label: Parent Portal
seo_description: Fees, attendance, announcements, assignments, results, and messaging—responsive by design.
headline: Give families a clear window into school life.
subheadline: Fees, attendance, announcements, assignments, report cards, and messages converge in a portal tuned for busy caregivers—on phones and desktops, with role-safe visibility.

segments.title: Financial clarity
segments.body: Statements, receipts, and balances parents can find without calling the office.

segments.title: Academic visibility
segments.body: Attendance, assessments, and report cards in one official channel.

segments.title: Official communications
segments.body: Announcements with traceability—not lost threads across chat apps.

problem_section.title: Families deserve one coherent channel
problem_section.body: When updates arrive through fragmented chats and PDFs, engagement drops. RunMyCampus concentrates fees, attendance, grades, announcements, and messages into a portal tuned for busy parents.

bullets: Mobile-friendly clarity without chasing admin for every detail
Fewer repetitive inquiries at the front office
Delivery patterns that respect cohorts and campuses
Balances parents see align to invoicing discipline in finance
A communication posture you can explain to boards and families
